Harbour kept grey skin. First boat cut it. She stood at quay with notebook. Wrote names of boats she knew. Blank line for ones she did not. Man in yellow coat hauled crate. Crane turned once. Stopped. Turned back.

Rain thickened. She stayed. Office had lamp and chair facing cabinet. She had turned chair last winter. Nobody turned it back. She counted gaps between horns, then gaps between horns and clock. Wrote only gaps.
